description: Returns a payment link for one of the three ways to keep the book: voices, book, or keepsake, which is the printed hardcover. The price is on Stripe’s page, which takes the card and, on the keepsake, the postal address. This tool never takes a card and never names a price.

option.description: voices, book, or keepsake. Only the keepsake is printed and posted.
